Chapter 14: The Joy of Anticipation—Longing for the World to Come.
You know, there’s a kind of longing that goes way deeper than anything this world can offer. It’s that hope for something more—a yearning for a world that’s finally made right. If you’ve ever read through the Valley of Vision, you’ll notice so many of the prayers are looking past today, reaching out for a future where everything is made new. These prayers really capture that ache for home, for justice, for true peace.
Imagine someone who’s experienced both the beauty and the brokenness of life—those moments of pure joy, but also times of loss and disappointment. The prayers in this section don’t pretend the pain isn’t there. Instead, they gently lift your eyes to what’s ahead. They remind you of a hope that’s steady—a day when every single tear will be wiped away.
There’s this thread of longing and expectation running through each prayer. They ask for patience while we wait, faith that can hold on, and the strength to keep living with hope. What they really teach is that this world isn’t the end of the story. The best is still to come.
If you’re feeling tired or discouraged, these prayers can bring real comfort. They remind you that every bit of sorrow will be redeemed, and every deep longing will finally be satisfied. The Valley of Vision encourages us to live with anticipation—to be ready for what’s promised, and to see our lives now in the light of eternity.
